fact: A DGI communique of 29 April 2024 told IBP taxpayers trained in télédéclaration to file their results account and reconciliation table online, and said omission counts as no return, while taxpayers of offices not yet on télédéclaration are entered by account managers.
title: Modernisation fiscale en RDC : la DGI invite les contribuables à la télédéclaration pour l'exercice fiscal 2024
